error[ZBX-E1016]: Rosetta is not installed on this Mac
  while  preparing to run a linux/amd64 command
  cause  Rosetta is not installed on this Mac; linux/amd64 commands run through
         it
  fix    install it once:                                         softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license
         then stop the machine, so that it starts with Rosetta:   zbx vm stop
  more   zbx explain E1016
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1016.html
